neighbours.label: Fires on a named sugar read as a dietary sweetener or nutrient — fructose (token 'uctose') near max, agave at about half, sucrose about a third, glucose itself not registering — and only weakly on the same word as a chemical (~0.25) or a proper name (~0.16), or on bare 'sugar' in a single sentence (~0.18, rising to ~0.5 inside long sugar-focused text).
fire: Because the liver handles fructose differently from glucose, a daily soda habit can quietly raise triglyceride levels.
Many breakfast cereals are sweetened with high-fructose corn syrup even when the box advertises whole grains.
A ripe pear owes much of its sweetness to fructose, the sugar that makes fruit taste sweeter than bread.
Dietitians point out that honey is roughly forty percent fructose, so it is not a free pass for diabetics.
The ingredient list on the energy bar led with fructose, dextrose and maltodextrin before any actual nuts.
Researchers tracking teenagers found that those who drank the most fructose-sweetened beverages gained the most weight.
Compared with glucose, a dose of fructose barely nudges insulin, which is why some old diet guides recommended it.
Vegan bakers often reach for agave nectar as a sweetener because it blends smoothly into batters and cold drinks.
quiet: Plenty of breakfast cereals are loaded with sodium even when the box advertises whole grains and fiber.
The soft texture of a ripe pear comes from pectin breaking down as the fruit hangs on the tree.
Nutrition counselors remind patients that honey still packs plenty of calories, so it is no free pass for diabetics.
Public health campaigns now urge parents to treat sugar as a weekend indulgence rather than a lunchbox staple.
Compared with butter, a spoonful of olive oil barely moves cholesterol, which is why Mediterranean diet guides recommend it.
On the protein bar's wrapper the ingredient list named whey, almonds and sea salt before any flavorings.
Fans of the indie band Fructose queued around the block for the reunion show in Leeds.
In the crystallography lab she indexed the X-ray diffraction spots from a single crystal of fructose cooled to liquid nitrogen temperature.
